entries.name: Spider-Man: Shattered Dimensions
entries.reason: Depth clamp removed the black or duplicated band in the tested tutorial. Vulkan depthClamp support is required; other Dimensions and GPUs are not fully verified.

entries.name: Need for Speed: The Run
entries.reason: The asynchronous fence fixes are included in the emulator. Optional graphical patches are separate choices and are not enabled by this profile.

entries.name: Divinity II: The Dragon Knight Saga
entries.reason: Corrects the dark, striped character editor in the tested scene on Odin 3 / Adreno 830 with the system driver (build 60511358). Uses an existing accuracy option; gameplay and other GPUs are unverified. May cost performance, especially with MSAA. No FPS gain is guaranteed. Keep depth_float24_round at its default false.

entries.name: Blue Dragon
entries.reason: Experimental and partial: boolean constant specialization corrected the opening scene, but incorrect colors returned after four videos. The separate Turnip T30 workaround is not applied automatically.

entries.name: Fable II GOTY
entries.reason: Enables floating-point depth to correct the blue and white band in the tested introduction. Other scenes and GPUs are not fully verified.

entries.name: Alan Wake
entries.reason: Requires direct UMA resolve readback; without resolve readback the game renders black and is not playable.

entries.name: Rise of the Tomb Raider
entries.reason: The general pixel-shader vertex-fetch fix and depth clamp correct the main geometry and colors in the tested opening scene. Isolated colored polygons remain unresolved. Requires build 60410911 or newer and Vulkan depthClamp. The clamp stays off globally. The rest of the campaign, other GPUs and original Xbox clipping semantics are not fully verified.

entries.name: Grand Theft Auto IV
entries.reason: Tests the direct system-memory rendering path while the tiled GMEM device-loss investigation remains open.

entries.name: BioShock 2
entries.reason: Enables the HDR alpha correction verified for water and reflections. Other scenes and GPUs are not fully verified.

entries.name: Peter Jackson's King Kong
entries.reason: The file I/O option prevents the Venture startup freeze in the verified tests. Occasional missing textures remain under investigation.

entries.name: Assassin's Creed
entries.reason: Uses strict occlusion queries to prevent missing and flickering geometry.

entries.name: Splinter Cell Conviction
entries.reason: Uses the documented conservative settings for ordered SNORM processing, selective transfers and asynchronous work, while disabling read-only attachment stores. This does not guarantee a cure for intermittent device loss.
